cleanup.meaning: Disposable fixture cleanup, including fixture repositories and their registrations. This is not evidence of safe cleanup of arbitrary user-owned worktrees or helper-provided recovery.

limits: Remote is a local self-reference; no hosted remote, fetch transport, fork, push or PR publication is verified.

No arbitrary dirty-state safety, credential isolation, permission enforcement, race safety or cross-platform result.

These lawful positive paths do not independently establish hostile-path containment.

Keep keyboard-focus and visual claims unverified until corresponding current-page observations exist; screenshot-save success is insufficient.
Retain the separate native Worktree supplement and its A 2/3 versus B 3/3 intent accounting.
Preserve the original failed assertion, original runner and recovery protocol; do not claim first-run case outcomes that were not persisted.
Keep intentional ref and registration changes explicit instead of treating primary HEAD/index preservation as a completely untouched repository.
Retain the narrow Worktree prose/help correction without attributing new native behavior to it.
Track generic-validator schema compatibility separately; do not erase a supported repository field merely to imply a previously passing baseline.
Do not promote these local fixtures, read-only interpretations or source diffs into autonomous workflow, cross-platform, field-outcome, runtime-refresh or release-completion claims.
